findings.title: Supabase service-role key shipped in the client bundle
findings.detail: An env var named NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY gets inlined into every visitor's browser bundle by Next.js design — the NEXT_PUBLIC_ prefix is the bug here, not a bundler flaw.
findings.recommended_fix: Never prefix a service-role/admin key with NEXT_PUBLIC_. Server-only secrets should have no client-exposed name at all; use a server action or API route as the boundary.

findings.title: Real .env committed to a public repo's git history
findings.detail: Removed from the current tree in a later commit, but git history isn't rewritten — anyone can still `git show` the earlier commit and recover the same credentials.
findings.recommended_fix: If a secret is ever committed, rotating it is mandatory — removing the file from the current tree does not un-leak it. Use git-secrets or gitleaks as a pre-commit hook going forward.
